tweaks.name: Ultimate Performance power plan (falls back to High Performance)
tweaks.why: Keeps the CPU out of deep idle states between frames and stops aggressive downclocking, which removes a common source of frame-time spikes. Created as a separate 'SteadyFrame Ultimate Performance' plan so the original plans stay untouched.
tweaks.breaks: A few extra watts at idle. Desktop only.

tweaks.name: Keep the Balanced plan (dual-CCD Ryzen X3D)
tweaks.why: On the 7900X3D/7950X3D/9900X3D/9950X3D, AMD's 3D V-Cache driver parks the non-V-Cache cores while a game runs, and it relies on the Balanced plan plus Xbox Game Bar to do it. High/Ultimate Performance breaks that and costs FPS.
tweaks.source: AMD chipset driver guidance for dual-CCD X3D processors

tweaks.name: Disable USB selective suspend
tweaks.why: Stops Windows from putting USB ports to sleep to save power, which causes mouse/keyboard/headset hiccups and random disconnects.

tweaks.name: Disable PCI Express link power management (ASPM)
tweaks.why: ASPM lets the GPU/NVMe link drop into low-power states; waking it back up adds latency. Desktops don't need the savings.

actions.label: PCI Express link state power management

tweaks.name: Disable hibernation and Fast Startup
tweaks.why: Fast Startup restores a saved kernel/driver state instead of doing a clean boot, a classic cause of 'my PC is weird after shutdown' problems. Also frees a hiberfil.sys about 40% the size of your RAM.
tweaks.breaks: The Hibernate option; cold boots take a few seconds longer.
